name: no part overlaps another (every tab inside its slot)
section area as computed from the plates
Iy (vertical bending) as computed from the plates
Iz (sideways bending) as computed from the plates
the measured section lies between the tabs, the bulkhead slots and the cutouts
expr: xSec + 0.2 mm < xB0 + dT / 2 - tabHalf && xSec + 0.2 mm < xB0 + tBh / 2 + min(cWebT, cWebB, cWebL, cWebR)

name: bulkheads: nB of them, bhS apart
end plate bolt holes: nHy x nHz
rule: slots at least 2 x the plate from its edge
expr: min(if(eTL, ovTL - clrTL - 2 * tcTL, 0 mm), if(eTR, ovTR - clrTR - 2 * tcTR, 0 mm), if(eBL, ovBL - clrBL - 2 * tcBL, 0 mm), if(eBR, ovBR - clrBR - 2 * tcBR, 0 mm))

name: rule: tabs into thick plate leave a plug weld pocket of at least 3 mm and reach 50 to 75 %
expr: (!plugTL || tcTL - lenTL >= 3 mm) && (!plugTR || tcTR - lenTR >= 3 mm) && (!plugBL || tcBL - lenBL >= 3 mm) && (!plugBR || tcBR - lenBR >= 3 mm) && (!plugST || tTop - lenST >= 3 mm) && (!plugSB || tBot - lenSB >= 3 mm) && (!plugSL || tLeft - lenSL >= 3 mm) && (!plugSR || tRight - lenSR >= 3 mm) && f >= 0.5 && f <= 0.75

name: rule: tabs at least 1.5 x their plate wide
expr: min(if(eTL, wTL / tbTL, 9), if(eTR, wTR / tbTR, 9), if(eBL, wBL / tbBL, 9), if(eBR, wBR / tbBR, 9), if(oT, 9, min(wST / tBh, wET / tEnd)), if(oB, 9, min(wSB / tBh, wEB / tEnd)), if(oL, 9, min(wSL / tBh, wEL / tEnd)), if(oR, 9, min(wSR / tBh, wER / tEnd)))

name: rule: tabs at most tabPitch apart
rule: reliefs at least 0.2 mm and fit their slots
expr: min(rdTL, rdTR, rdBL, rdBR, rdST, rdSB, rdSL, rdSR, rdET, rdEB, rdEL, rdER) >= 0.2 mm && swTL > 4 * rdTL && swTR > 4 * rdTR && swBL > 4 * rdBL && swBR > 4 * rdBR && swST > 4 * rdST && swSB > 4 * rdSB && swSL > 4 * rdSL && swSR > 4 * rdSR && swET > 4 * rdET && swEB > 4 * rdEB && swEL > 4 * rdEL && swER > 4 * rdER

name: rule: webs between the bulkhead and end plate slots and the edge joints at least half the plate
expr: min(if(oT, 1 m, clip + gST / 2 - wST / 2 - clrST - rdST - max(clrTL, e1TL + rdTL, clrTR, e1TR + rdTR) - tTop / 2), if(oB, 1 m, clip + gSB / 2 - wSB / 2 - clrSB - rdSB - max(clrBL, e1BL + rdBL, clrBR, e1BR + rdBR) - tBot / 2), if(oL, 1 m, clip + gSL / 2 - wSL / 2 - clrSL - rdSL - max(clrTL, e1TL + rdTL, clrBL, e1BL + rdBL) - tLeft / 2), if(oR, 1 m, clip + gSR / 2 - wSR / 2 - clrSR - rdSR - max(clrTR, e1TR + rdTR, clrBR, e1BR + rdBR) - tRight / 2), if(oT, 1 m, clip + gET / 2 - wET / 2 - clrET - rdET - max(clrTL, e1TL + rdTL, clrTR, e1TR + rdTR) - tTop / 2), if(oB, 1 m, clip + gEB / 2 - wEB / 2 - clrEB - rdEB - max(clrBL, e1BL + rdBL, clrBR, e1BR + rdBR) - tBot / 2), if(oL, 1 m, clip + gEL / 2 - wEL / 2 - clrEL - rdEL - max(clrTL, e1TL + rdTL, clrBL, e1BL + rdBL) - tLeft / 2), if(oR, 1 m, clip + gER / 2 - wER / 2 - clrER - rdER - max(clrTR, e1TR + rdTR, clrBR, e1BR + rdBR) - tRight / 2))

name: rule: cutouts at least 2 x the plate from every joint and from each other
expr: min(cRimT - 2 * tTop, cWebT - 2 * tTop, cRimB - 2 * tBot, cWebB - 2 * tBot, cRimL - 2 * tLeft, cWebL - 2 * tLeft, cRimR - 2 * tRight, cWebR - 2 * tRight)

name: length
label: Length
description: Length of the beam (x), end to end

name: width
label: Width
description: Width over the side plates (y); the lips of top and bottom plates that lie on the sides come on top of it

name: height
label: Height
description: Height over the top and bottom plates (z); the lips of side plates that lie on them come on top of it

name: tTop
label: Top plate
description: Thickness of the top plate

name: tBot
label: Bottom plate
description: Thickness of the bottom plate

name: tLeft
label: Left side plate
description: Thickness of the left side plate (y = 0)

name: tRight
label: Right side plate
description: Thickness of the right side plate

name: capTL
label: Top left edge
group: Edges: which plate lies on which
choices: Top plate on the side plate
Side plate on the top plate
description: The plate that lies on the other carries the slots, set in from its edge (its lip); the other plate's edge carries the tabs

name: capTR
label: Top right edge
group: Edges: which plate lies on which
choices: Top plate on the side plate
Side plate on the top plate
description: The plate that lies on the other carries the slots, set in from its edge (its lip); the other plate's edge carries the tabs

name: capBL
label: Bottom left edge
group: Edges: which plate lies on which
choices: Bottom plate on the side plate
Side plate on the bottom plate
description: The plate that lies on the other carries the slots, set in from its edge (its lip); the other plate's edge carries the tabs

name: capBR
label: Bottom right edge
group: Edges: which plate lies on which
choices: Bottom plate on the side plate
Side plate on the bottom plate
description: The plate that lies on the other carries the slots, set in from its edge (its lip); the other plate's edge carries the tabs

name: ovK
label: Lip (x plate thickness)
group: Edges: which plate lies on which
description: How far a plate that lies on another reaches past it, in its own thickness, beyond the fit clearance: at least 2 (a slot 2 x the plate from the edge)

name: openWall
label: Open side
description: Leave one wall out; the bulkheads and end plates then end at that side. A channel is far weaker in torsion than a closed box, and one open to the side twists under a vertical load unless it acts through its shear centre (an output)

name: cutTop
label: Top plate
description: Lightening and access holes in the top plate, in every bay between two bulkheads

name: cutBottom
label: Bottom plate
description: Lightening and access holes in the bottom plate, in every bay between two bulkheads

name: cutLeft
label: Left side plate
description: Lightening and access holes in the left side plate, in every bay between two bulkheads

name: cutRight
label: Right side plate
description: Lightening and access holes in the right side plate, in every bay between two bulkheads

name: cutRim
label: Rim beside the cutouts
description: Plate left along each long edge, from the inside face of the wall across (at least 2 x the plate)

name: cutWeb
label: Web between the cutouts
description: Plate left between two cutouts and between a cutout and a bulkhead (at least 2 x the plate); the width of a truss diagonal

name: cutRadius
label: Cutout corner radius
description: Radius in the corners of the rectangles and triangles (smaller where a cutout is too small for it)

name: tBh
label: Bulkhead thickness
description: Thickness of the bulkheads (inner cross plates)

name: bhSpacing
label: Bulkhead spacing
description: Bulkheads at most this far apart, evenly between the first and the last

name: bhEnd
label: First bulkhead from the end
description: Distance from each end of the beam to the middle of the first and the last bulkhead; at half the length there is one bulkhead in the middle

name: bhHole
label: Hole in the bulkheads (%)
description: Diameter of the hole in each bulkhead, in % of the smaller inside size (at least 8 mm: a vent for the welding and a way through for cables)

name: endPlates
label: End plates
description: Close both ends with a plate inside the walls, flush with their ends

name: tEnd
label: End plate thickness
description: Thickness of the end plates

name: hole
label: Bolt holes
description: Holes in the end plates on a grid: clearance holes (ISO 273 medium) or tap drill holes (ISO 2306); with none, a vent hole in the middle

name: holePitch
label: Bolt hole pitch
description: Spacing of the bolt holes, centred, at least 2 x the hole from the walls

name: tabPitch
label: Tab spacing
min: 2 * max(wTL, wTR, wBL, wBR) + 4 * tBh + 20 mm
description: Tabs at most this far apart, along the edges and along the bulkheads and end plates

name: tabDepth
label: Tab depth in thick plate (%)
description: How far a tab reaches into a plate thick enough for a plug weld (a pocket of 3 mm or more is left); in thinner plate a tab goes through and stands 0.2 x the plate proud, to be fused

name: fitExtra
label: Extra fit clearance
description: Added to the clearance per side between every tab and its slot (0.05 mm + 2.5 % of the thicker plate): for a cutter whose kerf compensation leaves the slots tight

name: material
label: Material
description: Plate material: its density, stiffness and design strength (aluminium as welded: the strength of its heat-affected zone)

name: support
label: Supports
choices: Cantilever: fixed at one end, load at the free end
Simply supported at both ends, load in the middle
Fixed at both ends, load in the middle
description: How the beam is held over its length, for the strength outputs

name: load
label: Point load (N)
description: A vertical force, downwards, at the free end or in the middle (10 N is about 1 kg)

name: lineLoad
label: Spread load (N/m)
description: A vertical load spread over the whole length, on top of the beam's own weight

name: torque
label: Torque (N m)
description: A twisting moment about the beam's axis, at the free end or in the middle (a tool force times its arm, on a gantry)
